common.tagline: Local-first · files stay on this machine

home.title: Home
home.emptyTemplates: No templates yet. Import a DOCX file to get started.
home.workflow1: Import a DOCX template; its placeholders are configured automatically.
home.workflow2: Create a run; copy the generated extraction prompt.
home.workflow3: Give the prompt and your documents to any AI you trust.

newRun.descriptionBefore: A run is a self-contained directory under

run.welcomeTitle: Create a document in a few steps
run.welcomeDescription: Choose a template and add the files you want to use. FillForge will extract the details for you to review before making your document.
run.noTemplatesDescription: Import a DOCX template to get started.
run.localHint: Your files stay on this computer until you choose Extract with AI.
run.supportedFiles: PDF, images, text and Markdown · up to 50 MB total
run.sourceSecureHint: Original files are kept with this document run.
run.aiReadyDescription: FillForge uses your default AI connection to read the selected source files and fill in this template.
run.aiTransmissionNote: Source files and the template extraction prompt are sent to your selected AI provider when you continue.
run.aiNotConfiguredTitle: Connect an AI service to continue
run.aiNotConfiguredDescription: Add a default AI connection in Settings. Your connection details stay on this device.
run.addSourceFirst: Add at least one source file to continue.
run.reviewSubtitle: Check and correct anything before creating the document.
run.createDocumentHint: Your edits will be saved with this document.
run.promptToolsDescription: Use these tools to run extraction with another AI or import a prepared extraction result.
run.title: Run
run.attachmentsEmpty: Optional. Attach evidence (invoice photos, PDFs) to keep it with the run.
run.promptEmpty: Generate the prompt, paste it together with your documents into any AI, then import the JSON it returns below.

run.reviewNoteBefore: Editing a value keeps the original AI value untouched: corrections are stored in

history.title: Run history
history.description: Completed documents and work in progress are saved here.
history.confirmClearDescription: Run details and source files will be removed. Every generated DOCX will be kept in Saved documents.
history.confirmDelete: Delete this run? Its DOCX files will be saved.
history.clearPartial: Cleared {{deleted}} runs. {{failed}} could not be cleared.
history.cleared: Run history cleared. {{count}} document files preserved.
history.failuresRemain: {{count}} runs could not be cleared and remain in history.
history.preserveNote: Deleting history never removes generated DOCX files. Clearing history removes only local run data; it does not erase data kept by your AI provider.

editor.name: Name
editor.placeholdersSynced: The template has been updated from its DOCX placeholders.
editor.promptEmpty: Configure at least one field to generate the extraction prompt.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceDescription: Choose how FillForge looks on this device.
settings.aiConnectionsDescription: Connect an AI service for automatic document extraction. API keys are stored in your operating system credential store.
settings.dataDescription: Manage local runs and keep generated documents safe.
settings.localDataDescription: Runs, source files and intermediate data stay on this computer. Generated DOCX files are preserved when you delete run history.
settings.historyCleanupHint: To review or clear run history, open History from the Run page. Clearing history does not delete data stored by your AI provider.
settings.noConnections: No AI connections yet. Add one to use automatic extraction.
settings.defaultConnectionNote: The default connection is used on the Run page.
settings.endpointHint: Use HTTPS, or HTTP only for a service running on this computer.
settings.keySavedPlaceholder: Saved securely · enter a new key to replace
settings.keyPlaceholder: Enter API key (optional for local endpoints)
settings.keyStoreHint: Keys are saved only in your operating system credential store. They are never sent back to this screen.
settings.modelsHint: Discover models from the endpoint, then add the ones you want to keep.
settings.modelLimitReached: A connection can contain up to 256 models.
settings.modelsFound: Found {count} models. Add the models you want to use.
settings.modelVerified: The endpoint verified this model. Add it to the connection to save it.
settings.connectionSaved: Connection saved. The API key is stored securely.
settings.modelsTruncated: Model list loaded; the endpoint returned more models than can be shown.
settings.connectionPrivacy: When you choose Extract with AI, the selected files and extraction prompt go to this provider. Responses discovery may send a small model verification request with no files. Test connection sends a small request with no files.
settings.storedAfter: . New runs use the selected prompt version.
